title: Derive safety-constrained optimization recommendations
goal: Derive deterministic optimization recommendations from verified metrics while proving that mandatory checks prerequisites security floors and evidence obligations remain invariant.
outputs: safety invariant proof for every recommendation
invariants: optimization cannot remove mandatory or prerequisite-closed safety gates
absence or corruption of metrics cannot weaken validation
raw source code and secrets are never stored as optimization evidence
security_properties: recommendations are advisory until separately verified
security and correctness floors outrank throughput optimization

performance_budget.rationale: this layer exists to reduce engine overhead without trading away safety
metrics: ordinary PR validation overhead from metrics collection remains negligible compared with selected checks

rollback.strategy: revert E8 changes while retaining verified E0-E7 behavior

definition_of_done: no recommendation may disable a mandatory check
no recommendation may break prerequisite closure
insufficient evidence yields no optimization recommendation
